let generators : Array (Array Nat) := #[
    #[0, 1, 2, 3, 10, 11, 7, 6, 12, 9, 4, 5, 8, 13, 14, 15, 20, 23, 24, 19, 16, 22, 21, 17, 18, 25],
    #[0, 1, 2, 9, 4, 7, 11, 5, 12, 3, 10, 6, 8, 13, 14, 19, 21, 17, 24, 15, 22, 16, 20, 23, 18, 25],
    #[0, 1, 4, 3, 2, 12, 11, 8, 7, 9, 10, 6, 5, 13, 14, 16, 15, 25, 24, 21, 20, 19, 22, 23, 18, 17],
    #[0, 1, 5, 3, 6, 11, 12, 10, 7, 9, 8, 2, 4, 13, 18, 15, 16, 23, 24, 22, 20, 19, 21, 25, 14, 17],
    #[0, 3, 2, 1, 5, 4, 6, 7, 12, 9, 11, 10, 8, 13, 15, 14, 18, 17, 16, 19, 24, 22, 21, 23, 20, 25],
    #[13, 17, 14, 23, 16, 20, 19, 15, 24, 25, 21, 22, 18, 0, 4, 10, 6, 3, 7, 2, 11, 12, 8, 9, 5, 1]]
let roots : Array Nat := #[1,2,3,5,13,15,17,18,28,31,32,34,42,43,44,46,47,55,56,61,62,63,66,71,72,73,74,75,76,83,84,85,86,92,96,100,101,102,104,105,106,113,114,115,151,152,156,158,159,160,161,162,163,164,168,169,171,172,173,391,392,394,395,404,421,423,424,432,434,451,452,453,454,456,460,461,462,463,511,516,519,520,521,546,548,549,550,782,811,858,884,888,913,914,924,941,943,1001,1003,1004]
let ren (ks : List Nat) (i : Nat) := ks.foldl (fun j k => (generators[k]!).getD j j) i
let col (i : Nat) : (BitVec 52 × BitVec 468) :=
  let a := rawColumns[0]!
  let b := rawColumns[13]!
  if i == 26 then (a.1 &&& b.1,a.2 &&& b.2)
  else if i == 27 then (a.1 ||| rawColumns[14]!.1,a.2 ||| rawColumns[14]!.2)
  else if i == 28 then (rawColumns[1]!.1 &&& b.1,rawColumns[1]!.2 &&& b.2)
  else rawColumns[i]!

let gate (k : Nat) (ks : List Nat) : (BitVec 52 × BitVec 468) :=
  let a := col (ren ks ((k / 29) % 29))
  let b := col (ren ks (k % 29))
  if 841 ≤ k then (a.1 &&& b.1,a.2 &&& b.2) else (a.1 ||| b.1,a.2 ||| b.2)

let joinCols (a b : (BitVec 52 × BitVec 468)) : (BitVec 52 × BitVec 468) := (a.1 ||| b.1, a.2 ||| b.2)
let start (k : Nat) : List (BitVec 52 × BitVec 468) := (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 29 => col i.val)) ++ [gate k [],(0,0),(-1,-1)]
let step (s : List (BitVec 52 × BitVec 468)) (g : Nat × Nat) : List (BitVec 52 × BitVec 468) :=
  s ++ [joinCols (s.getD g.1 (0,0)) (s.getD g.2 (0,0))]

∀ k : Nat, k < 1682 → ∀ gs : List (Nat × Nat), ∀ i : Nat,
    ((gs.foldl step (start k)).getD i (0,0)) ≠ (-1,0)
